notes.title: Galaxy Defenders Alpha 0.4 – The Disruptor Tower Arrives!
notes.content: [h2]🚀 Galaxy Defenders (Classic TD) – Alpha 0.4 Update[/h2][p]Defenders, a fresh update has landed! Here’s what’s new in [b]Alpha 0.4[/b]:[/p][h3]🆕 New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Disruptor Tower[/b] – Unlockable in the shop! Slows enemies and now comes with multiple upgrade levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Targeting Options[/b] – Towers can now switch between 3 targeting modes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop Additions[/b] –[/p][list][*][p]Reset option with enhanced descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]New Shop icons for Coins, Speed, Tower Core, Tower Upgrade Chance, and Disruptor Tower[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed tower list and UI update issues when building or leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected versioning display (no more mix-ups between 0.3 and 0.4).[/p][/*][*][p]Volume slider race condition fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚠️ Development Note[/h3][p]Work on [b]new levels[/b] is paused until procedural map generation (with pathing & symmetry options) is ready. This will take time, but it’s a big step forward for future content.[/p][p]💡 Keep your feedback coming—it helps shape the game![/p]

notes.title: Alpha 0.3 – Towers, Turrets, Trouble (Public Release Now Live)
notes.content: [h2][b]Alpha 0.3 – Public Release![/b][/h2][p]The game is now available to everyone! Alpha 0.3 brings a ton of improvements, new features, and polish across the board. Here's what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 [b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Tower Count Limits:[/b] Towers are now limited per type, with visual indicators to help you plan more strategically.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tower Upgrade Circles:[/b] Visual indicators show which towers are upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p][b]First-Time Map Intro:[/b] The first map now plays a short intro the first time you load it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bonus Tower Display:[/b] See how many bonus towers you'll earn on the next map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Separate Music & FX Volume Controls:[/b] Fine-tune your audio experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firing Animations:[/b] Turrets now visually rotate and fire (Tower 1 & 2).[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Developer Tools:[/b] Internal tools for managing tower limits and spawn data — this helps us build content faster and better.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ [b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Wave Difficulty Balancing:[/b] Enemy waves have been rebalanced for a smoother difficulty curve.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pause Menu Fixes:[/b] No more getting stuck or unpausing in the wrong context.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Camera Controls:[/b] Minimum height lowered for better tactical views.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Name Input Fix:[/b] Player names can now include numbers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Build Menu Feedback:[/b] Build UI now turns gray properly when no tower cores are available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Tutorial Page:[/b] More clarity for new players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop Price Fixes:[/b] Small balance tweaks to shop values.[/p][/*][*][p][b]General UI Optimization:[/b] Menus feel snappier and more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Polish:[/b] Several small visual fixes for a cleaner look.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This is a big step forward for the game, and we’re excited to finally open the gates to new players! Your feedback is more important than ever — join us on Discord and help shape what's next.[/p]
